html:
SMTO-EXE-0209 — The list of pages doesn't work for this PDF action

GUID: 882431e7-a929-5bdc-a159-acaf2952623e
Slug: pdf-page-selection-invalid
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: pdf

What happened

  • The pages chosen for this action don't fit its rules, such as leaving a page out of a reorder or deleting every page. Nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. To reorder pages, list every page of the document exactly once in the new order. Leaving a page out of a reorder would silently drop it, so SMTO refuses.
  2. To delete pages, keep at least one page in the document. A PDF with no pages can't be created.
  3. When splitting a PDF, keep the total number of pages across all the new parts at 100 or fewer. Split larger files in several requests. One split request can handle at most 100 pages in total.
  4. Make sure each page number appears only once in your request. Repeated page numbers are refused so pages aren't copied by accident.

What success looks like

  • SMTO completes the action and the new PDF has the pages you expected, in the right order.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the page list you asked for, to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The PDF page selection was rejected: a reorder that does not list every page exactly once, a delete that would remove every page, split groups totalling more than 100 pages, or an empty, duplicated or over-100 page list.

What this means

  • Page selection was empty, duplicated or over its selection bound, reorder did not cover every page exactly once, deletion removed all pages, or split selections exceeded their combined bound. PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.

Why this can happen

  • Page selection was empty, duplicated or over its selection bound, reorder did not cover every page exactly once, deletion removed all pages, or split selections exceeded their combined bound.

How to diagnose it

  • Check selection uniqueness/count and operation-specific reorder, split and minimum-retained-page requirements.

How to fix it

  • reorder must list every page exactly once, delete_pages must leave at least one page, and the combined size of all split groups must not exceed 100 pages. Selections must be unique 1-based page numbers, at most 100 per request (the argument schema already rejects most empty or duplicated lists as pdf.invalid_request).
  • Supply unique 1-based page numbers. Reorder requires every page exactly once; deletion must retain a page.

Retry and execution caution

  • Supply unique 1-based page numbers. Reorder requires every page exactly once; deletion must retain a page.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended bounded page plan validates against the current source without unintended omissions.

What not to do

  • Never automatically replay uncertain writes or execute embedded document content.

Technical notes

  • PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
